📋 12 Entry Points

Licensing

Export Licensing — OGEL, OIEL, SIEL, ECJU

OGEL for routine transfers. OIEL for repeat approved-destination shipments. SIEL for specific consignments. ECJU processing times and conditions. Military List classification — ML1–ML22. Arms Export Criteria — human rights, regional stability, diversion risk. Licence data for Parliamentary reporting. SIEL refusal grounds and appeal process.

FMS

Foreign Military Sales — US FMS, LOA, DSCA, ITAR

FMS route for UK components in US-origin systems. LOA structure and lifecycle. DSCA oversight, Congressional notification thresholds ($14M/$50M). ITAR — US Munitions List categories. TAAs. Re-transfer restrictions. FMS surcharge. Offset exclusion. British defence content tracking in US programmes.

G2G

Government-to-Government — G2G Framework, MOD Sponsor

G2G — MOD as contracting authority. DIT DSO support. MOD sponsor — requirement validation, pricing approval, delivery assurance. G2G vs DCS. Contract types — FFP, cost-plus, TCI. GFE provisions. DASA pricing methodology. Profit rates per SSRO baseline.

Offset

Offset & Industrial Participation — Tech Transfer

Offset obligations — 50–100% contract value. Direct — co-production, subcontracting, tech transfer. Indirect — unrelated goods/services. Credit valuation — % FOB. ITAR/classified transfer limitations. NIP vs IP. Penalty clauses. Countertrade. Monitoring and enforcement. UK defence industrial base preservation.

Support

Through-Life Support — Spares, Training, Upgrades

ISP — spares provisioning, tech pubs, training. CLS arrangements. PBL availability contracts. TLSA structure. Spares — rotables, consumables, obsolescence. Operator/maintainer training. Depot-level maintenance. Mid-life upgrade. Export-specific in-country support and remote diagnostics.

Compliance

Export Compliance — End-Use, Diversion, Sanctions

EUC verification. Diversion risk — re-export, third-party transfer. OFSI sanctions screening. UN/EU/US sanctions lists. Arms Export Criteria (Consolidated Criteria). Country risk matrix. ECO post-shipment verification. Licence condition enforcement. PQ evidence on export decisions. Ministerial override record.

CADMID

CADMID Procurement — Concept to Disposal

Concept — Initial Gate, URD. Assessment — Main Gate, cost, risk register. Demonstration — prototyping, TRLs. Manufacture — production contract, QA. In-service — support contract, obsolescence. Disposal — demilitarisation, environmental. IAC assurance. Whole-life cost modelling. Gateway reviews.

Partnerships

International Partnerships — Five Eyes, NATO, AUKUS

Five Eyes interoperability. NATO STANAGs — equipment compatibility. AUKUS Pillar I (subs), Pillar II (advanced capabilities). Bilateral defence cooperation. COEP. Foreign Comparative Testing. NSPA. OCCAR. ITAR/GDF exemption pathways. Joint qualification/certification.

Pricing

Pricing & Costing — DASA, Profit Rates, SSRO

DASA pricing methodology. SSCR — SSRO oversight. Baseline profit rate benchmark. Allowable costs — direct, indirect, capital. Profit rate adjustments — risk, performance, efficiency. CPR formula. Pricing Note submission. DefCred 7007 transparency. Reporting Regs 2015. Post-DLOD adjustments.

Data

Data Governance — Export Data, Classification

ECJU database — licence application data. MOD/DE&S sales reporting. Classification — OFFICIAL through TOP SECRET. GSCP compliance. Air-gapped networks, secure transfer. PQ evidence preparation. FOI exemptions — defence, international relations. 6-year retention. Cross-dept sharing — MOD/DIT/FCDO/HMRC.

Parliamentary

Parliamentary — PQ Evidence, Select Committee

PQs on defence exports — licence decisions, policy. Export licence statistics — quarterly, annual. Defence Select Committee — equipment procurement. FAC — arms export policy. CAEC scrutiny. Written/oral evidence. Ministerial statements. Opposition debates. APPGs. Cross-party briefing packs.

Intelligence

Market Intelligence — Competitor, Capability Gaps

Competitor analysis — US, France, Israel, Russia, China. SIPRI/Jane's market sizing. UK export performance stats. Capability gap analysis. Market opportunity — GCC, Indo-Pacific, NATO east flank. Win/loss analysis. RFI/RFP monitoring. DIT DSO strategy alignment.

⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Export Licence Automation

AI-driven ECJU licence processing. Automated ML classification from tech specs. Risk pre-screening — human rights, diversion, stability. Parallel OGEL/OIEL/SIEL processing. Condition compliance checking. Target: 80% auto-classified, processing time reduced 60% from 20-day SIEL benchmark.

2. FMS Case Management

Digital FMS lifecycle — LOA generation, Congressional tracking, delivery scheduling. ITAR compliance automation — access control, re-transfer monitoring. DSCA integration. British content tracking. Surcharge billing. Target: 100% cases digitally tracked, zero ITAR breaches, notification lead time 30 days.

3. G2G Pricing Engine

DASA-compliant pricing engine for G2G sales. SSRO profit rate from current baseline. Allowable cost categorisation. Pricing Note auto-generation. SSCR compliance checking. Target: Zero SSCR non-compliance, PN generation from 4 weeks to 48 hours, 100% DASA methodology.

4. Offset Compliance Tracker

Offset obligation tracking and credit allocation. Direct/indirect balance monitoring. Tech transfer approval workflow. Penalty risk assessment. Countertrade matching. Credit valuation automation. Target: 100% obligations tracked digitally, credit recovery from ~70% to 95%, zero penalty triggers.

5. Through-Life Support Optimisation

Predictive maintenance AI for export platforms. Spares demand forecasting. Obsolescence early warning. PBL metric automation. In-country support assessment. Remote diagnostics. Target: 30% spares stockout reduction, predictive maintenance reducing unplanned downtime 40%.

6. Sanctions & Compliance Screening

Real-time OFSI/UN/EU/US sanctions screening. EUC verification AI — doc authenticity, entity matching. Diversion risk scoring. Post-shipment verification. Target: 100% transactions screened within 24 hours, zero sanctioned-entity exports, diversion flagged pre-licence.

7. CADMID Digital Twin

Digital twin of CADMID lifecycle for export programmes. IAC evidence automation — cost, risk, schedule. Gateway review readiness. Whole-life cost modelling. Obsolescence planning. Target: All major export programmes (>$50M) with digital twin, IAC pack from 8 weeks to 1 week.

8. Parliamentary Evidence Engine

Automated export licence stats — quarterly, annual, by destination/equipment. PQ evidence — pre-approved data extracts. CAEC pack generation. Select Committee briefing. Refusal/appeal tracking. Target: Real-time reporting, PQ response from 5 days to 24 hours, zero incorrect stats.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No export licence recommendation without Arms Export Criteria compliance — every decision must assess human rights, regional stability, diversion risk per Consolidated Criteria
  • ❌ No G2G sale priced outside DASA/SSRO methodology — all G2G contracts must comply with SSCR and Defence Pricing baseline
  • ❌ No ITAR-controlled tech transferred without USG approval — re-transfer/re-export of US-origin defence articles requires prior DSCA/State Dept authorisation
  • ❌ No defence equipment exported to sanctioned entities — real-time OFSI/UN/EU/US sanctions screening mandatory for every transaction and EUC
  • ❌ No offset obligation recorded without verified industrial participation — all credits validated against delivery evidence, no advance credit without ministerial approval
  • ❌ No Parliamentary evidence without source verification — all PQ answers, Select Committee evidence, export stats traceable to verified MOD/DIT/ECJU systems

2

3

4
Scale: Roll out across MOD defence equipment sales. Integrate ECJU, DSCA, OFSI, SSRO APIs. Deploy across all export routes. Offset tracking for all active programmes. Parliamentary reporting for CAEC and Defence Select Committee.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade defence export governance. Licence compliance dashboards. Parliamentary evidence generation. Pricing audit trail. Sanctions screening logs. Offset credit verification. CADMID lifecycle tracking. Cross-dept data governance.
